notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Maine has no local sales tax; the 5.5% general rate applies everywhere.
Prepared food is taxed at the state's 8% rate and lodging at 9%; those are taxability questions for the restaurant categories, not part of the general rate.
